facts.fact: In an interview published 4 March 2025 the Minister of Communication, Posts and Digital Economy, Sidi Mohamed Raliou, said "aujourd'hui, nous ne disposons pas d'une politique en matière de numérique" and that the policy he had drawn up would be rolled out only once adopted; he adds that without a policy "validée par le gouvernement" work goes on "en désordre".
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement du numérique 2026-2035

facts.fact: The minister said the ministry had "élaboré" a national digital development policy covering all sectors of the administration, which was "en adoption" and awaiting adoption "par le gouvernement"; he named no adopting act or date.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement du numérique 2026-2035

facts.fact: The minister said the policy has an action plan that is "déjà élaboré" and will be rolled out once the policy is adopted; he gave no cost for it.
facts.system: Politique nationale de développement du numérique 2026-2035
